visual_brief: Jengish Chokusu has a broad, rounded-to-flat summit crown above a huge banded north wall of rock, snow and hanging ice. Classic views look up the Zvezdochka Glacier from South Inylchek basecamp or across from Khan Tengri, particularly in alpenglow. Avoid confusing it with Khan Tengri’s sharp pyramid, foreground spires, or the subsidiary Pobeda West and East summits.
notes: Eight distinct JPEGs downloaded and visually checked; all long sides are at least 1600 px. Best choices: c1, c5 and c7. SummitPost licence wording comes from its page footer; no separate image licence appeared. Country Highpoints also displays an All rights reserved footer. Metadata saved in research.json. Repository follow-up check was unavailable because its configured Python executable is missing.
